skill.codex_strategy: Codex has no Skill tool. Load a named skill by reading its SKILL.md with exec_command and following those instructions. Project skills live at `{repo-root}/{{skills_dir}}/{name}/SKILL.md`. Plugin and bundled skills still need their SKILL.md opened the same way — a catalog listing does not load a skill.
skill.grok_strategy: Grok Build has no Skill tool. Load a named skill by reading its SKILL.md with read_file and following those instructions. Project skills live at `{repo-root}/{{skills_dir}}/{name}/SKILL.md`. Plugin and bundled skills appear in the session catalog with a path — read that path. A catalog listing or slash command does not load the skill for a spawned subagent.
skill.antigravity_strategy: Antigravity has no separate Skill tool. Load a named skill by reading its SKILL.md with view_file and following those instructions. Project skills live at `{repo-root}/{{skills_dir}}/{name}/SKILL.md`. Plugin and bundled skills appear in the session catalog with a path — read that path.

delegate.antigravity_strategy:
Every ultracode agent ships as an Antigravity subagent already, so the spawn `TypeName` is exactly `ultracode-{agent}` — a dash, never a colon, matching the `name:` in `{plugin-root}/agents/{agent}.md`. **Never call `define_subagent` for one of these agents.** A definition you write by hand replaces the shipped prompt with your summary of it, and the agent that then runs is not the one this pipeline expects; if a spawn is refused as not found, report that the plugin is misinstalled instead of defining a replacement.

`invoke_subagent` is asynchronous. The call returns `Created the following subagents: {conversationId: ...}` immediately — that is an acknowledgement, not a result. Each agent's actual answer arrives later as a `[Message]` system message, and that message IS its return: read the verdict, report, or findings from there. Never poll, never sleep, and never re-spawn an agent because its file is not on disk the moment its message lands: `factcheck.json` is written from that message by hooks/agy-message-record.js — under the `Repo key:` that spawn declared — on the next tool call or model invocation after the message arrives. So a gate call issued in the same breath as the message can lose the race and answer `current: none recorded` for a verdict that has already arrived — when that happens, call `ultracode_gate` once more with the same arguments and it succeeds. The other cause of `none recorded` is a `repo_key` that is not the one the fact-check spawn carried, which no amount of retrying fixes: re-read both and call again with the matching key. Never re-spawn the fact-check agent over either, and never write the file yourself.

ask_user.grok_strategy: There is no structured question tool. Ask the user in the conversation and wait for their reply.

plan.grok_strategy: There is no plan-mode tool. Present the plan in the conversation and wait for approval before implementing.
plan.antigravity_strategy: There is no modal plan tool. Present the plan in the conversation and use ask_question or prompt for approval before implementing.
